scripts.lint: pnpm -r --if-present lint && uv run --directory services/agent ruff check . && uv run --directory services/agent ruff format --check . && uv run --directory evals ruff check . && uv run --directory evals ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run --directory services/agent ruff format . && uv run --directory services/agent ruff check --fix . && uv run --directory evals ruff format . && uv run --directory evals ruff check --fix .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && uv run --directory services/agent mypy && uv run --directory evals mypy
scripts.test: uv run --directory evals python -m unittest latency.test_harness
